verdict.rationale: smolagents is an agent framework whose core function is generating code/tool-calls to act on data (e.g., web search example, SQL query example in community evidence), which can surface insights, but this is developer-oriented and requires building the analysis workflow yourself rather than a built-in 'insights' UI or dashboard. missing for 10: a first-party example of automated data-analysis/insight generation presented to an end-user, dedicated 'insights' feature or UI, and independent corroboration beyond a single anecdotal HN thread.
